data.name: Sudden Sting
data.description: You can inflict a lingering, painful sting as a swift action that requires a successful melee touch attack. This sting deals 1d4+%1 points of piercing damage, and the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC %2) or become staggered for 1 round. This is a pain effect. You can use this ability %3 times per day.|DomainVerminLVL/2|10+DomainVerminLVL/2+CON|DomainVerminTimes
